key_results: Pilot-first long dwell allows burnt pilot products to cool/lean before interaction; H2-first long dwell can move main ignition beyond H2 EOI into a lean region.
Pilot-only schlieren ignition delays: 0.62±0.04 ms at 890 K, 0.93±0.05 ms at 820 K, 1.68±0.12 ms at 780 K.

mechanisms.summary: Authors link successful H2 ignition to duration/location of interaction with reacting pilot products and to the H2 mixture state when that interaction occurs.

evidence_candidates.claim: Main-fuel ignition follows a finite interaction with reacting/burnt pilot products, and the required interaction duration depends on dwell and charge temperature.
Ignition after H2 end of injection produces slower propagation and persistent lean unburned zones.
